evaluation.panel_status: The shared evaluation panel has already been observed. This extension is specified after reviewing the parent campaign; do not describe it as a new unseen qualification panel.

analysis.aggregation: Equal weight for all three completed training checkpoints per arm; show individual seed results and between-seed variability.
